text:
nick: Heads-up: I'm proposing a router-level contract called 'header-lite' that strictly guarantees only routing, retention_hint, trace_id, and an opaque billing_token. All other attrs move to async materializers. Purpose: reduce parser CPU and control tag cardinality explosion. Goal is a safe rollout plan not a spec fight.
ara: +1 for reducing cardinality. Important: billing determinism must be synchronous. billing_token must be resolved into billing_key in the fast router synchronously (cheap lookup). If the token is missing, route to best-effort pipeline.
jules: we should include explicit fields: retention_hint, sample_hint, trace_id, billing_token, body_ref, body_checksum, schema_v. sketch:
```json
{"hdr":{"trace_id":"t_01","billing_token":"tok_42","retention":"long","sample_hint":false,"schema_v":"v3","checksum":"sha256:..."},"body_ref":"s3://ingest/2026/part-0001.avro"}
```
tariq: tracing note: trace_id must be injected at the edge/sidecar if absent. async materializers must preserve trace_id when emitting enrichment events so the stitcher can reconstruct a single logical trace.
ara: retention: some consumers assumed lane-level TTL (analytics90 / billing365). We need per-envelope retention_hint and storage router must honor it. Also add a canonical enum: short|default|long.
nick: sampling: policy rules proposal: if billing_token present -> force full materialization and bypass sampling; else use sample_hint. Add sample_override boolean for ops. This avoids double-charge when analytics sample.
jules: operational: materializers must be idempotent. Use body_checksum+schema_v to detect replay. Also maintain a small join-index mapping body_ref -> enriched_attrs for ad-hoc queries to avoid regressions. Index should be compact and TTL-aligned with retention_hint.
tariq: migration plan idea: 1) accept header-lite alongside existing lanes; 2) enable header-lite routing for non-billing tenants at 5% traffic; 3) verify billing latency & error rates; 4) promote cohorts and eventually billing tenants after SLO verification; rollback by flipping routing per cohort. rollback window suggestion: 2 hours for billing cohorts, 30m for others.
ara: metrics to watch: billing_latency_p50/p95, parser_cpu_ms_p50, attr-cardinality-rate (new tags/min), join-index-hit-rate, stitcher-latency. Need clear alert burn thresholds.
icked: typo :)
jules: bench request: can infra run a header-only decode perf across current production payloads and a full decode baseline? We need p50 < 1ms target for header decode. @infra-bot
infra-bot: perf job scheduled: ci/obs/header-lite-decode-4112233445. Results ETA 18h. Link: https://ci.redwood/obs/bench/4112233445
tariq: corner case: backfills. If we backfill enriched attrs, we must not retroactively change billing attribution. Materializers must record materialization_time and materializer_id and join-index must be append-only with last_seen_checksum to prevent flip-flopping.
ara: schema-evo: schema_v field in hdr required. Materializers must support forward/backward compat flags. If schema_v mismatch, route to a quarantine bucket and alert on low-volume sample.
jules: action items: nick to draft RFC with header-lite schema + retention enum + sampling override rules + migration checklist. infra to post perf numbers. stitcher prototype: @tariq. Rollout owner: @nick.
nick: will draft RFC and link it here. Thanks all — let's keep this lean and schedule a quick sync after infra numbers. :white_check_mark:
